meta.scope: Current discounted Steam games plus curated discounted DLC, passes, bundles and packages. Live game rows are discovered from Steam's US specials index; curated rows preserve known promotion end dates and provenance.
meta.method: Live Steam specials discovery for the Games category, merged title-first with the existing curated catalog. Steam app IDs and broad Steam genres are retained when available.
meta.important: Live Steam prices and discounts can change at any time. Rows without ends_at were discovered as currently discounted but do not have a verified promotion end date.
meta.link_policy: Steam app links use steam_appid when available; title search remains the fallback.
